status: review.2 design contract; not an implemented runner or passed test

assertions: catalog asset and role references valid
themeOnly.limits: No claim of rendered readability or play quality

mixedBatch: Any gameplay operation requires one full-batch candidateHash runtime smoke; never execute/test partial batch.

requiredAssertions: at least one actual logical tick
immutable candidate snapshot and changed parameter/position loaded
no Runtime fault or budget overrun
recorded events and actualValues agree with candidate rules and phase
smoke.noWitness: Record uncovered behavior; never infer win, route solvability, fairness or untriggered mechanic coverage.

specificOutcomeClaims.noWitness: Downgrade statement to prediction/untested; cannot claim actual verification.

applicationGate: Static checks plus passed runtime smoke for gameplay; static checks plus runtime_not_applicable for pure theme only. Any other status denies application. Recheck candidateHash and current authorization/version at confirmation.

candidateHash.canonicalization: UTF-8 compact JSON; recursively lexicographic object keys; operations array order retained; candidateState.scene.entities ASCII id sorted; integer/-0 rules as C10
candidateHash.semanticHash: Separate C10 gameplay projection; hash is association, not authorization or file field

source: machine_test, never peer_human or author real play
invalidation: Any candidate content/version/operation changes require rehash and rerun. Canceled, timed-out, stale or adult-disabled requests cannot unlock application.
genericUnitTest: Supplementary only; never substitutes for the concrete candidateHash trial.

applicability.set_reward_values: blocked when reward count=0; absent class value may remain but has no current score contribution
applicability.move_entity: blocked if stable entityId absent; never retarget another entity
applicability.set_goal: cannot turn zero-reward/insufficient-total draft into an eligible gameplay candidate unless full supported batch restores playability
applicability.set_timer: legal with zero guards; never auto-enable timer when last guard removed
applicability.entityWrites: add_entity/copy_entity/remove_entity not supported; return manual step without formal operations or fake proposed candidate
